key_finding: res.partner.bank is partner-scoped not company-scoped; company derived from partner; uniqueness is per-partner not global; Thai PromptPay uses account_qr_code_emv proxy_type/value extended by l10n_th; no l10n_th_bank_branch in Community 19; payment.provider is a separate model.

claims.statement: res.bank is the bank-institution registry with fields: name (required), bic, country, active, email, phone, address. It is separate from res.partner.bank.
BIC/SWIFT is stored on res.bank (not res.partner.bank), is indexed, and is force-uppercased on every create and write operation.

Core fields: acc_number (required Char), sanitized_acc_number (stored computed), partner_id (required Many2one to res.partner), bank_id (optional Many2one to res.bank), company_id (stored related from partner_id.company_id, read-only).
sanitized_acc_number strips all non-word characters (spaces, dashes, dots, etc.) and uppercases the result. It is stored and used for the uniqueness constraint and acc_number search.
Module-level function sanitize_account_number() applies re.sub(r'\W+', '', acc_number).upper(). Called in _compute_sanitized_acc_number, _search_acc_number, and _sanitize_vals.
SQL UNIQUE constraint on (sanitized_acc_number, partner_id). The same canonical account number may exist for different partners. Constraint is NOT globally unique.

acc_type is a non-stored computed Selection field. Value is determined at runtime by retrieve_acc_type(acc_number). Base implementation always returns 'bank'. base_iban overrides to attempt IBAN validation and return 'iban' on success.

validate_iban() in base_iban: (1) normalizes input, (2) checks 2-char country prefix against _map_iban_template dict, (3) checks length and alphanumeric regex vs template, (4) performs mod-97 check on rearranged string. Thailand (TH) is absent from the template map.
On create/write, if acc_number passes IBAN validation it is silently reformatted to groups-of-4 format via pretty_iban(normalize_iban(...)). Original spacing/formatting not preserved.
base_iban extends _get_supported_account_types() via super() chain to add ('iban', 'IBAN') alongside base ('bank', 'Normal'). Additional localization modules may add further types.

company_id is a stored related field from partner_id.company_id and is readonly. Bank accounts are not directly scoped to a company; they follow their partner's company. Multi-company isolation is enforced through the journal constraint.

account module adds journal_id One2many (domain type=bank). A constraint in account/res_partner_bank raises ValidationError if len(bank.journal_id) > 1. One bank account may link to at most one journal.

account.journal.bank_account_id is Many2one to res.partner.bank. Constraint at line 586-594: (1) bank_account_id.company_id must match journal.company_id; (2) bank_account_id.partner_id must equal journal.company_id.partner_id.
base/res_bank.py overrides unlink() to call action_archive() and return reload action. active field (default True) supports archive/restore. Records are never hard-deleted from the base model.
account/res_partner_bank.py create() raises UserError if an inactive (archived) bank account already exists for the same partner + acc_number combination, preventing duplicate-key violations.

allow_out_payment defaults False. Enabling requires group account.group_validate_bank_account or base.group_system. Once trusted, acc_number, sanitized_acc_number, partner_id, and acc_type are locked from modification.

account_qr_code_emv module defines proxy_type = Selection([('none','None')]) and proxy_value = Char on res.partner.bank. This is the base for all country-specific QR proxy extensions including Thai PromptPay.

l10n_th extends proxy_type with: ('ewallet_id','Ewallet ID'), ('merchant_tax_id','Merchant Tax ID'), ('mobile','Mobile Number'). QR payload encoded as EMV tag-29 with AID A000000677010111 per Thailand BOT PromptPay spec.

merchant_tax_id must match ^[0-9]{13}$; mobile must match ^[0-9]{10}$. QR limited to THB. Mobile encoding: leading '0' replaced by '66', zero-padded to 13 chars. Validated on create+write via @api.constrains.

migration_flags.description: allow_out_payment defaults False on import. All migrated bank accounts will be untrusted and blocked from outgoing payments until manually trusted by an authorized user.
No l10n_th_bank_branch field exists in Community 19. Thai bank branch data from legacy systems has no native target field. Custom field or notes field required.
company_id on res.partner.bank cannot be set directly during import. It derives from partner_id.company_id. Company alignment must be achieved by assigning the correct company to the partner first.
Uniqueness constraint is (sanitized_acc_number, partner_id) not global. Same account number for different partners is allowed. Migration must deduplicate within each partner's account list.
l10n_th PromptPay fields depend on account_qr_code_emv being installed. Verify module installation order in migration plan.

open_questions.q: Does the customer's legacy system store branch codes per Thai bank account? If so, a custom field (e.g. x_bank_branch) is needed in Community 19.

Are any existing bank accounts in the legacy system linked to companies as account holders (not individual partners)? The journal constraint requires partner_id == company.partner_id for journal-linked accounts.
